global_assumptions.payout_mode: annual aggregate dividend assumption, retained cash added only at exit
global_assumptions.model_period: five forward 12-month periods from decision date, not completed FY27 actual results

assumption_rationale.working_cash_ebitda_margin: 25.5% versus H1 statutory EBITDA excluding other income and net ESOP credit 25.84%. Risk-cost charges remain expenses. Future stock grants represented by share dilution, not a second cash deduction.
assumption_rationale.revenue: 2750 forward first-year revenue is the lower end of issuer FY27 full-year guidance, repurposed as an analyst forward run-rate assumption. Growth6% is below H1 services growth12.7%, not a forecast of contract fulfilment.
assumption_rationale.capex: 200 first year and6.5% future revenue, including growth, maintenance, and capital-creditor/advance cash timing. Materially above100–125 issuer FY27 capex guide. No cash-flow149.442 deduction is reclassified away as proven.
assumption_rationale.leases: 110 first year versus H1 actual53.810*2=107.620, all principal+interest charged, not only interest.
assumption_rationale.working_capital: 30 first year and25% of later incremental sales. No receivable-day reduction or old loan collection used to manufacture base owner cash. Future net customer financing is included in the total cash budget.
assumption_rationale.tax: 25.168% on EBITDA minus lease cash and nonlease depreciation proxy. This is a cash-tax approximation, not a reproduction of tax returns. Deferred tax credit not treated as spendable.
assumption_rationale.treasury: Cash+current+noncurrent investments only, less100 liquidity reserve. Other bank, deposits/claims in financial assets and customer loans excluded. Zero treasury interest means no capitalized profit plus asset double count.
assumption_rationale.downside_risk_reserve: 75 one-time extra working-capital/litigation/closing shock reserved from liquid assets. This is stress assumption, not accrued liability or allegation.
assumption_rationale.dilution: 0.5% annual working/upside and1% downside future-share sensitivity, not a verified outstanding options tally. Last issued denominator retained as dated. Full March option overhang with proceeds is separately tested.

fy26_cash_capex_bridge.qualification: Roll-forward differences may include acquired balances or other noncash movements. A residual is retained explicitly, not forced to zero.

share_verification.limitation: Bounded current announcement search is not an exhaustive certified absence-of-allotment proof. Scenarios apply0.5% annual future dilution and separately stress March2026 option overhang.
